facts.event: Liran 第二次宣告“To dancing!”，众人合力把长桌抬到墙边清出舞池，Tilde 被他拉下舞池。
facts.relation: Liran（国王）与 Tilde（王后）、Elise 及全体廷臣
facts.anchor: in tradition, the men put their hands beneath the table, and Elise joined them

facts.event: Alar 向 Isen 索要妹妹共舞，Elise 冷拒，Isen 挡在中间说“She said no”，第一次替她顶住长兄。
facts.relation: Elise、Isen（同母弟）、Alar（长兄）三兄妹；Isen 护妹
facts.anchor: ‘She said no,’ said Isen. ‘Time you learned what that means.’

facts.event: Conrin 与 Gundobar 把 Tilde 架到壁炉边，在她耳边下令，Tilde 便伸手探入火焰；Elise 立刻喊“女人的舞”打断。
facts.relation: Conrin（王弟）与 Gundobar（Palati）合谋对付 Tilde；Elise 出手救人
facts.anchor: commanded something and she reached out her hand to the flame.

facts.event: Tilde 在舞中含糊求救“How to die”，Elise 由此断定她中的不是酒，而是血魔法“the glory”。
facts.relation: Tilde 向 Elise 求救；Elise 是唯一看懂的人
facts.anchor: Elise knew the truth of what Tilde had been given. Blasphemy. Blood magic.

facts.event: Hadiah 把戴着银蓝戒指的手凑到 Tilde 唇边，戒指宝石由蓝转灰再转黑，Marolyn 据此断定为毒，并追问 Muirenn 在哪。
facts.relation: Hadiah、Marolyn（Tilde 的 Merogian 女官）忠于王后；众人怀疑失踪的 cupbearer Muirenn
facts.anchor: its clear stone went from blue, to grey, to black.

facts.event: Elise 掀开新挂的壁毯按下暗门，把 Tilde 三人藏进密道，又用母亲刻的天鹅骨梭卡住门框，把追来的 Gaisa 挡在门外；她在门缝里看见 Muirenn 正与 Gaisa 私会。
facts.relation: Elise 与 Gaisa（王弟）、Muirenn（Suneish 女仆）对立；Elise 护 Tilde、Marolyn、Hadiah
facts.anchor: She took two steps forward, reaching behind a new-hung tapestry of a couple kissing in a garden

facts.event: Elise 借血魔法的服从规则命令 Tilde 闭嘴，Tilde 立刻安静；她掰开王后下唇，见舌与唇尽黑。
facts.relation: Elise 以施术者身份压制 Tilde；Tilde 沦为被操控者
facts.anchor: ‘Queen Tilde, you will be silent,’ she commanded. ‘I order you to heed me.’

facts.event: Elise 讲出“the glory”的配方（天鹅肝加血与金，在月影下炼制），并推算上一次月影月是围城后两周。
facts.relation: Elise 向 Marolyn、Hadiah 吐露家族秘术；施毒者指向她的兄弟或 Muirenn
facts.anchor: Distilled from a swan’s liver, mixed with blood and gold under a shaded moon.
